items.text: Since the Act was gazetted on 20 February 2026, adults may possess up to 56 g of cannabis or 15 g of resin without criminal liability (s 6(5), Eighth Schedule).

Smoking or using cannabis in, or within 5 m of the entrance, exit, window or air intake of, a public place, workplace or public transport: XCD 300 fixed penalty, or up to XCD 5,000 on summary conviction (s 13B).
Using cannabis on or near school premises: up to XCD 250,000 and 7 years summarily (s 13C). Home growing needs prior registration with the Cannabis Secretariat.

layers.process: Entry to the Molinière/Beauséjour Marine Protected Area, which holds the Underwater Sculpture Park, is charged per person per visit to all visitors, divers, snorkellers and explorers alike. It is set in steps: USD 3.50 from 15 May 2025, USD 7.00 from 1 October 2026 (about A$9.94, RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040), and USD 10.00 from 1 October 2027. Pay through the Pure Grenada payment portal. The authority's release also lists Fisheries Act fees (no start date given): scuba dive or snorkel USD 10 (EC$27) per person per day; overnight yacht charter USD 25 (EC$67) per day; one-hour mooring buoy permit USD 10 (EC$27).

facts.label: Official residence authority
facts.text: Temporary and permanent residence routes for foreigners are administered by Immigration and Passport Division, Grenada. Read the current official route names, minimum presence and fees on that site.

citizenship.summary: Official naturalisation, descent and dual-citizenship rules in Grenada, for an Australian passport holder.

facts.label: Dual citizenship (destination rule)
facts.text: Whether the destination allows dual citizenship should be confirmed on the official nationality pages. Do not assume that a residence permit leads to citizenship, or that Australia's rule applies there.

facts.label: Citizenship by descent
facts.text: Many countries have a descent route with official documentary conditions. Confirm eligibility on the official nationality pages before planning around it.

facts.label: Official authority
facts.text: Start with Immigration and Passport Division, Grenada for official naturalisation, descent and dual-citizenship rules.

citizenship.notes: Australian law also matters: Australia allows its citizens to hold another citizenship. That does not change the destination country's own dual-citizenship rules.
